verdict.rationale: Morph is built to be driven by AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex) that issue natural-language edit/search instructions via MCP tools (edit_file, codebase_search) and the Anthropic Messages/OpenAI-compatible API, so NL commands from an agent do drive Morph's fast-apply and search functions. However Morph itself has no direct end-user NL chat interface — it's consumed as an API/tool layer, and the evidence never shows a user typing free-form commands directly to Morph outside of an agent intermediary. Missing for 10: a native NL/chat interface for direct end-user commands, independent confirmation of NL-driven MCP tool use in production.
